hero.title: Who We Are
hero.description: Welcome to 360 Tours and Investment Limited, where unforgettable travel experiences begin. We create exciting, safe, and seamless journeys across Ghana and beyond, with guided tours, comfortable stays, and reliable transport under one roof.
hero.tagline: Explore More. Travel Better. Experience Africa with 360 Tours.

company.name: 360 Tours and Investment Limited
company.subtitle: Your trusted travel partner for tours, accommodation & transportation

story.intro: Welcome to 360 Tours and Investment Limited, your trusted travel partner for unforgettable experiences across Ghana and beyond. We specialize in creating authentic, exciting, and personalized tours that allow travelers to experience the rich history, vibrant culture, breathtaking landscapes, and warm hospitality that Africa is known for.
story.story: 360 Tours and Investment Limited is a registered travel and tourism company dedicated to showcasing the very best of Ghana and Africa. We are passionate about connecting travelers with unforgettable destinations, unique cultural experiences, and world-class customer service.
story.journey: From the bustling streets of Accra to the historic castles of Cape Coast, the serene waters of Akosombo, the lush rainforests of Kakum, and the breathtaking waterfalls of the Volta Region, we help our guests discover Africa from a local perspective.
story.commitment: Our goal is to provide personalized travel experiences that leave lasting memories while supporting sustainable tourism and local communities. Whether you're visiting for leisure, business, heritage exploration, or adventure, our experienced team is committed to making every journey safe, comfortable, and memorable.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To deliver exceptional travel experiences through quality service, professionalism, and authentic cultural connections while promoting sustainable tourism throughout Ghana and Africa.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To become Africa's leading travel and tourism company by inspiring travelers to explore the continent through unforgettable experiences, outstanding service, and innovative travel solutions.

tourServices.label: Guided City Tours
tourServices.description: Explore Ghana's vibrant cities with knowledgeable local guides who bring every destination to life.

tourServices.label: Historical & Heritage Tours
tourServices.description: Visit UNESCO World Heritage Sites, slave castles, museums, memorial parks, and historical landmarks that tell the story of Ghana's rich past.

tourServices.label: Adventure Tours
tourServices.description: Experience nature through hiking, waterfalls, canopy walks, boat cruises, wildlife parks, mountain excursions, and eco-tourism activities.

tourServices.label: Beach & Island Getaways
tourServices.description: Relax on beautiful beaches, enjoy island excursions, and experience Ghana's stunning coastline.

tourServices.label: Private Tours
tourServices.description: Customized itineraries designed around your schedule, interests, and travel style.

tourServices.label: Group Tours
tourServices.description: Perfect for families, friends, schools, churches, corporate organizations, and social groups.

supportServices.label: Hotel Reservations & Accommodation
supportServices.description: We arrange luxury hotels, boutique stays, beach resorts, apartments, guest houses, and budget-friendly accommodation matched to your preferences and budget.

supportServices.label: Transportation Services
supportServices.description: Travel safely and comfortably wherever your journey takes you with modern vehicles and professional drivers.

supportServices.label: Airport Transfers
supportServices.description: From the moment you arrive, we provide timely and comfortable transportation between airports, hotels, and tour locations.

supportServices.label: Customized Travel Planning
supportServices.description: Every traveler is unique. We create personalized experiences for relaxing holidays, cultural immersion, adventure, or family vacations.

faqs.question: How do I book a tour?
faqs.answer: You can book directly through our website, contact us via WhatsApp, email us, or call our customer service team.

faqs.question: Do you offer private tours?
faqs.answer: Yes. We customize tours for individuals, couples, families, and groups.

faqs.question: Can you arrange airport pickup?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We provide reliable airport transfer services throughout Ghana.

faqs.question: Are your tours suitable for families?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many of our tours are family-friendly and can be tailored for travelers of all ages.

faqs.question: Can you customize an itinerary?
faqs.answer: Yes. We create personalized travel plans based on your interests, budget, and schedule.

faqs.question: Do you organize corporate trips?
faqs.answer: Yes. We organize conferences, retreats, team-building activities, educational tours, and corporate travel services.

faqs.question: Do you offer visa on arrival assistance?
faqs.answer: Yes. We guide eligible travelers through Ghana's visa on arrival process, including required documents, fees, and airport procedures so your entry is smooth and stress-free.
